description: This Java class 'GenreStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods for analyzing book genres within a book tracking application. It includes functionality to determine the most-read genre, the most-liked genre based on ratings, and the least-liked genre among read books, utilizing internal data structures and streams for computation.

classes.name: GenreStatistics
classes.description: A class for computing statistics related to book genres in the reading context, such as most read, most liked, and least liked genres.

methods.name: findMostReadGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre that has been read the most across all books, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: findMostLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the highest total rating sum among read books, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: findLeastLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the lowest total rating sum among read books, wrapped in an Optional.
